s: a white Baroque castle on a peninsula in Sweden's largest lake
w: A dazzling white Baroque palace on the Kållandsö peninsula in Lake Vänern, built up from a medieval bishop's fortress into one of Sweden's grandest castles under Count Magnus Gabriel De la Gardie in the 17th century. Over 240 rooms, formal gardens, and water on almost every side make it a regular pick for the country's most beautiful castle.
_facts: Located on the Kållandsö peninsula in Lake Vänern, Sweden's largest lake
Originated as a medieval bishop's fortress, expanded into a Baroque palace in the 17th century under Count Magnus Gabriel De la Gardie
Has around 250 rooms and extensive formal gardens
Regularly ranked among Sweden's most beautiful castles in public polls
